stage1.purpose: Acquire, normalize, clean, and screen public conversations
steps: Lock source release and file hashes
Parse ordered messages and preserve original source keys
Count nonempty user messages from messages, not UI turn fields
Clean empty/invalid records and check language
Keep Search Arena paired branches linked by original row
Screen candidates and retain the frozen analytical source selection

stage2.purpose: Build coding units and refine the behavioral definitions
steps: Construct prefixes ending at each target user request
Identify tasks by goal continuity, preserving returns to earlier tasks
Code initial needs, multi-label actions, and outcome evidence separately
Iteratively refine boundary cases and examples
Check identifiers, quotations, field coverage, and task membership
Freeze selected records and derive five-function sets
stage2.main_rule_version: Original frozen main-sample coding; not retrospectively relabeled V13
